rationale: Production blue/green deployment is blocked. Accumulated migrations0117–0164 include incompatible old transcription dispatch retirement (0138), private result moves/clearing (0144), and provenance backfill plus terminal input/source clearing (0146). The current deploy engine migrates before stopping the active slot, so migrate/expand would falsely imply mixed-version safety. Release requires a separately reviewed maintenance or staged expand/contract plan and populated-data compatibility/rollback proof. Feature062 migration0165 itself changes only the same-signature runtime dispatch function, performs no DML/reset, removes diagnostic-history authority, and preserves bounded reason-scoped runtime cooldowns; its local forward behavior is independently verified. This classification intentionally makes the existing contract gate reject production deployment; it does not authorize a release, data reset or deployment-engine change. Feature063 migrations0166/0167 add private snippet/operation tables and new lease-fenced functions without replacing existing release contracts. Fresh-forward and role/application behavior are independently tested; this does not qualify the older accumulated migrations or authorize production deployment.
